rawSiteProfile.name: Frontier Firearms
rawSiteProfile.notes:
Audited 2026-04-06.
Platform: BigCommerce Blueprint (legacy, NOT Stencil). HTML contains BCData global and stencil refs but URL conventions are mixed .html (top-level legacy categories) + trailing-slash (newer categories). Generator meta tag is absent.
WAF: Cloudflare CDN in passive mode (cf-ray header present, no challenge). Desktop Chrome UA returns 200 with full ~410KB HTML. needsPlaywright=false.
Product count: sitemap-index via /xmlsitemap.php?type=products&page=1 returns 1286 product <loc>s on a single page; 5/5 HEAD samples returned 200. Replaces stale stream-page-count value of 374.
Pagination: ?page=N (query). Verified page 2 returns different products from page 1 on both /firearms.html (.html cat) and /equipment/ (slash cat). ?p=2 is silently ignored (returns page 1). Suffix-replace -2.html does NOT work (404).
Sort: <select id="sort" name="sort"> options include "newest"=Newest Items, alphaasc, priceasc, etc. ?sort=newest is the real param. On firearms.html the default order already matches sort=newest (default is newest-first), so the param is harmless additive — page 2 with sort yields strictly older products than page 1, confirming sort survives pagination.
CatalogUrls: dropped duplicates and clearance overlays.
  - /sport-optics/ ≡ /scopes-optics/ (Jaccard 1.0, 45/45) — kept /scopes-optics/.
  - /camping-outdoors.html ≡ /surplus-bags-hats-clothing/ (Jaccard 1.0, 288/288) — kept /surplus-bags-hats-clothing/.
  - /ammo-clear-out, /reloading-clear-out, /knife-clear-out, /hunting-clear-out, /accessory-clearout, /archery-clear-out, /bulk-buys/ — clearance overlays. Their products live under main categories. Dropped to keep minimum overlap; bootstrap discovers them from /xmlsitemap.php anyway.
  - Ammunition has no top-level URL — /ammunition-reloading/ and /ammunition-reloading.html both 404. Added 5 explicit ammo subcategories (centerfire/rimfire/shotgun/handgun/surplus).
  - /firearms.html=56, /scopes-optics/=45, /equipment/=200, /surplus/=260, /surplus-bags-hats-clothing/=288, /security-devices.html=4, /farm-supplies/=17, /power-equipment/=30, /shooting-accessories.html=73, /buy-online.html=30, ammo subcats=2+17+9+9+2.
Walked unique total via final catalogUrls: ~832/1286 (65%). Remaining ~454 are brand pages, orphan products, and items only reachable via /brands/ or product detail pages — bootstrap covers them via the sitemap.
crawlers.watermark.method=navigate-from-watermark (default order is newest-first; sort=newest survives pagination).

watermark.notes: Default category order is already newest-first; ?sort=newest is the verified BC sort param (option value="newest" in <select id="sort">) and yields identical first products as no-sort. Pagination preserves newest-first ordering (page 2 IDs are strictly older than page 1).
